notes: Business: SaaS provider that sells helpdesk and routing logic to retail merchants.
Goal: reduce agent TLDR time by auto-summarizing tickets and emailing threads into single-action lines and attaching normalized tags for routing to fulfillment/returns teams.
Current stack: Zendesk for support, Freshdesk being evaluated for regional clients.
Agent expectation: summary should be 1-2 bullet points + 3 suggested macros with confidence scores.
Throughput: baseline 40 req/s during normal day, up to 350 req/s during peak holiday spikes across their multi-tenant environment.
Latency SLO: median <250ms, P99 <900ms during spikes; willing to trade 50ms median for higher model fidelity on complex threads.
Data residency: EU tenant tickets must stay in EU region; prefer private control plane for EU customers.
Compliance: SOC2 required, plus ability to surface audit logs and deletion workflows on ticket deletion.
Tooling: need Zendesk app that can show inline summary, apply macro, or trigger webhook to fulfillment. Must support synchronous tool-call to update ticket fields.
POC scope: 10k historical tickets (EN/ES), 7 live shadow agents for 2 weeks, evaluate tag F1, macro acceptance rate, and latency under a synthetic spike test.
Success metrics: tag precision >0.82, macro accept rate >0.55, false tag rate <5% for top-20 tags.
Quote from Support Lead: "If the summary saves 8-12 seconds per ticket we can redeploy headcount to higher-value escalations."
